title: New car loan interest: the deduction most buyers miss
label: New for 2025-2028

hook.sub: Check where it was built first.

$200,000 married filing jointly. Personal use only.

cta.sub: We'll DM you our year-end tax checklist.

captions.instagram:
Buying a new car this month? The interest may be deductible.

✔️ New rule for 2025 to 2028: deduct up to $10,000 of car loan interest a year, even if you take the standard deduction.
✔️ The car must be new (original use starts with you) and have final assembly in the United States.
✔️ Used cars and leases don't count. The loan must start after Dec 31, 2024 and be for personal use.
✔️ It phases out above $100,000 of income ($200,000 joint). You'll need the VIN on your return.

Tip: check the build plant with the NHTSA VIN decoder before you sign.
Source: IRS, Working Families Tax Cuts.
